title_zh: 国内双 11 手机销量同比降 17%，畅销榜前五都是 iPhone
content_zh:
市场研究机构 Counterpoint 公布了今年双 11 的中国智能手机销量数据。按 10 月 12 日至 11 月 13 日的促销周期计算，国内手机销量同比下降 17%。Counterpoint 指出，零部件成本上涨压缩了厂商的降价空间，平台折扣未能抵消终端涨价。

苹果销量同比下降 8%，仍居品牌第一。iPhone 18 Pro Max 是这段时间卖得最多的单款机型，iPhone 占据前五名及前十中的六席，折叠屏 iPhone Duo 排第九。

华为是主要厂商中唯一实现销量增长的品牌，同比增幅为 29%，主要由畅享 90 Pro Max、Pura X View 和新上市的畅享 100 系列带动。Counterpoint 的另一项调查显示，未来半年有购机计划的中国受访者中，81% 已经注意到手机涨价。
title_en: China’s Singles’ Day Smartphone Sales Drop 17% as Apple Dominates Top Spots
content_en:
China’s smartphone sales fell 17% year-on-year during this year’s Singles’ Day shopping period (October 12 – November 13), according to data from research firm Counterpoint. The decline was primarily attributed to rising component costs, which squeezed margins and left platform discounts unable to offset higher retail prices.

Despite an 8% drop in sales, Apple retained its top brand ranking, with the iPhone 18 Pro Max emerging as the overall best-selling model. Apple swept the top five best-seller spots and took six of the top ten, including the foldable iPhone Duo in ninth place.

Huawei was the only major manufacturer to post growth, recording a 29% year-on-year surge driven by popular models such as the Enjoy 90 Pro Max, Pura X View, and the newly launched Enjoy 100 series. Meanwhile, a separate Counterpoint survey revealed that 81% of Chinese consumers planning to purchase a phone in the next six months have already noticed rising prices.

title_zh: 马斯克：美国每名儿童赠送两股 SpaceX 股票
content_zh:
马斯克在 X 上表示，计划向每名美国儿童赠送两股 SpaceX 股票，由公司和他本人各出一股。此前，他在 10 月提出的赠送方案是每人一股。

SpaceX 11 月 25 日发布的公告给出了公司部分的首批覆盖范围：每个目前处于活跃状态的特朗普账户将获赠一股新发行的 A 类普通股，马斯克承诺按公司捐出的股数等量配捐。这类账户是美国为儿童设立的税收优惠投资账户。SpaceX 总裁兼首席运营官格温·肖特韦尔也宣布，将另行捐出超过 200 万股。
title_en: Elon Musk Pledges Two SpaceX Shares for Every American Child
content_en:
Elon Musk announced on X that he plans to gift two shares of SpaceX stock to every child in the United States. Doubling his previous proposal of one share made in October, the updated initiative will be funded jointly, with one share donated by SpaceX and another matched personally by Musk.

SpaceX confirmed details of the program in a November 25 announcement, stating that initial coverage will target active "Trump Accounts"—tax-advantaged investment accounts established for American children. Additionally, SpaceX President and COO Gwynne Shotwell revealed she will separately donate over two million shares to the initiative.

title_zh: 黄仁勋质疑「10% 灭绝风险」，AI 教父辛顿公开反驳
content_zh:
据 TED 日前公开的访谈，诺贝尔物理学奖得主、被称为「AI 教父」的杰弗里·辛顿（Geoffrey Hinton）回应了英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋此前对 AI 灭绝风险预测的质疑，认为如果研究人员相信 AI 存在威胁人类生存的风险，却选择保持沉默，才是真正不负责任的行为。

此前，黄仁勋在接受《纽约时报》采访时，质疑辛顿关于 AI 可能导致人类灭绝的概率预测，认为「10%」这一数字缺乏科学研究依据，而且不断强调灾难性后果，会让公众对 AI 产生恐惧，阻碍技术的实际应用。

对此，辛顿表示，忽视真实存在的风险同样不负责任。他还反驳了黄仁勋对其过往预测准确性的批评，承认自己曾错误预测 AI 将迅速取代放射科医生，但强调早在 2009 年，他就预见到神经网络研究将需要大量英伟达芯片，而黄仁勋直到 2012 年才作出类似判断。

谈及 AI 的其他威胁，辛顿特别提到了大规模失业问题。他认为，科技公司领导者未必有意让大量劳动者失去工作，但在追求商业利润的过程中，利用 AI 替代人类劳动将成为自然结果。

辛顿还警告，AI 模型能力的进步速度已经超过人类理解其内部机制的速度。如果未来出现能力远超人类的 AI 系统，人类可能逐渐失去对这些系统的控制。他主张加强相关安全研究，并认为不同国家可以在 AI 安全领域展开合作。
title_en: 'AI Godfather' Geoffrey Hinton Rebuts Nvidia CEO Over Existential Risks
content_en:
In a recent TED interview, Nobel laureate and "AI Godfather" Geoffrey Hinton pushed back against Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s skepticism regarding AI existential risks. Hinton argued that researchers who foresee catastrophic threats to humanity have a duty to speak out, calling silence the "truly irresponsible" stance.

The debate follows earlier comments by Huang, who questioned Hinton’s estimate of a 10% chance of AI causing human extinction, calling it scientifically ungrounded. Huang warned that stoking fear over catastrophic scenarios creates public panic and hinders beneficial tech adoption.

Countering Huang's criticism of his past prediction record, Hinton stressed that ignoring real risks is equally dangerous. While acknowledging a previous misstep in predicting AI would rapidly replace radiologists, Hinton noted that he foresaw the need for Nvidia GPUs in neural network research back in 2009—three years before Huang reached the same conclusion.

Beyond existential risks, Hinton warned of immediate threats like mass unemployment driven by corporate profit motives. He also cautioned that AI capabilities are advancing faster than human understanding of their internal mechanics, urging global cooperation and safety research to prevent humanity from losing control of superintelligent systems.

title_zh: OpenAI 称 GPT-6.2 计费错误，后续相同任务将消耗更多额度
content_zh:
OpenAI 11 月 26 日确认，GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 上线时，多数用户的用量被错误地按较低标准计入额度。现已修正。

同样的工作会占用更多额度，OpenAI 预计，和上周相比，用户使用 Astra 时触及用量上限的速度会快 40%，使用 Sol 时会快 25%。
title_en: OpenAI Fixes GPT-6.2 Metering Glitch, Warning Users of Faster Quota Consumption
content_en:
OpenAI confirmed on November 26 that a billing glitch led to undercounting usage for its GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models since launch. The issue has now been resolved.

As a result of the fix, identical tasks will consume significantly more quota. OpenAI estimates that users will hit their usage caps 40% faster on Astra and 25% faster on Sol compared to the previous week.

title_zh: 小红书处置逾万篇虚假人设笔记，公布冒充医生引流等案例
content_zh:
小红书公布新一轮虚假人设治理结果，近期共处置违规笔记 1 万余篇、违规账号 547 个。这次公告列出的重点包括冒充专业人士牟利、以「人性测试」为名摆拍挑动对立，以及包装「玄学导师」引流收费。

小红书举例称，部分账号借白大褂和诊室布景冒充医生或中医，发布缺乏依据的诊疗说法，再通过互动话术把用户引向付费咨询。还有账号编排「豪车回乡」「试探农村老人」等剧情，或以「改运消灾」为由售卖商品、引流私域。公告所列案例的相关内容已下架，违规账号已封禁。
title_en: Xiaohongshu Cracks Down on Fake Personas, Banning Hundreds of Accounts
content_en:
Chinese social platform Xiaohongshu has announced the results of its latest enforcement campaign targeting misleading online personas, removing over 10,000 posts and banning 547 accounts.

The crackdown focused on fraudulent activities such as impersonating medical professionals to drive traffic to paid consultations, staging controversial videos to incite social conflict, and posing as spiritual gurus to sell products or redirect users to private chat groups.

Xiaohongshu stated that all violating content cited in the report has been taken down, and the associated accounts have been permanently banned.

title_zh: 八部门发布服务贸易五年规划，提出有序推动大模型服务出海
content_zh:
11 月 26 日，商务部公布与中央网信办、工信部等八部门联合印发的《服务贸易发展「十五五」规划》，将云计算、大模型等人工智能服务纳入出海方向。

规划提出，在防范技术外流的前提下，鼓励 AI 企业联合硬件厂商、算力供应商和基础设施运营商，将相关技术、产品和服务一并提供给海外客户。文件也支持企业与当地伙伴联合运营，进行本地化适配，并在共建「一带一路」国家推进农业、医疗、教育等领域的应用合作。

在数字贸易方面，规划提出建设国家数字贸易示范区，支持国际数据服务，将数据存储、加工、交易与安全防护纳入同一服务链。
title_en: China Unveils Service Trade Plan to Push AI and Large Models Overseas
content_en:
China's Ministry of Commerce, along with seven other government agencies, released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Service Trade Development on November 26. The blueprint explicitly highlights cloud computing and large AI models as key areas for international expansion.

Under the guidelines, AI companies are encouraged to collaborate with hardware manufacturers, computing providers, and infrastructure operators to export bundled technology solutions, provided that tech leak risks are managed. The plan also supports joint ventures with local international partners for localized adaptation, particularly advancing applications in agriculture, healthcare, and education across Belt and Road nations.

To bolster digital trade, China aims to establish national digital trade demonstration zones and develop integrated service chains that encompass data storage, processing, trading, and cybersecurity.

title_zh: 国家数据局就 AI 用数规则征求意见，涉及训练授权与数据付费
content_zh:
国家数据局 11 月 26 日公布《关于完善数据规则 赋能人工智能创新发展的若干意见》征求意见稿，拟明确企业在训练、推理中使用和提供数据的权利。征求意见截至 12 月 6 日，国家数据局计划通过试点推动落实。

按草案，企业可将经营活动中合法采集的数据用于训练和推理，前提是遵守法律与合同约定、不侵犯他人合法权益。企业可以取回或复制其使用智能设备、云服务时产生并授权服务商采集的数据。服务商使用这些数据训练模型或提供给他人使用，须得到企业明确授权。

草案还提出，鼓励 AI 企业通过采购、以数换数等方式为高质量数据付费，并探索将数据产权登记凭证作为判断买方是否履行合理注意义务的依据之一。数据处理者可留存数据来源、授权凭证和处理过程，供后续查验。
title_en: China Drafts Rules on AI Data Usage, Emphasizing Authorization and Paid Data Access
content_en:
China's National Data Administration released draft guidelines on November 26 to regulate data usage in artificial intelligence (AI) development, seeking public feedback through December 6. The agency plans to implement the rules through pilot programs to foster AI innovation while establishing clear legal boundaries for data use in model training and inference.

Under the draft proposal, businesses may use legally gathered operational data for AI training and inference, provided they comply with existing laws and contractual obligations. Service providers must secure explicit user authorization before using data generated from smart devices or cloud services for model training or third-party sharing. Additionally, enterprises retain the right to retrieve or copy data authorized to service providers.

To promote a sustainable data ecosystem, the draft encourages AI firms to compensate for high-quality data through purchases or data-swapping mechanisms. It also explores leveraging data rights registration certificates as proof of due diligence by buyers, while allowing data processors to maintain source logs and authorization records for compliance audits.

title_zh: 💡 宇树王兴兴：国内机器人年产能有望在 5 到 10 年内超过汽车
content_zh:
据 36 氪报道，在 11 月 26 日 WISE 2026 大会上，宇树科技创始人王兴兴表示，未来 5 到 10 年，国内机器人年产能有很大机会超过汽车。

他以 2000 万辆汽车的产能作参照，理由是机器人体积较小、机型较少，生产流程跑通后，同一座工厂能生产更多机器人。

王兴兴说，宇树从 2020 年起就尝试让人形机器人进入工业场景。他主张技术进步和商业化同步推进。目前机器人在进行物理接触时，最后几毫米的触觉反馈和动作控制仍有待突破，大模型做出的判断也需要和底层控制配合。

王兴兴提到，通用多模态模型和机器人专用模型可以相互补充。例如，前者有助于理解现场和决定接下来做什么，机器人还要靠更贴近硬件的控制系统把动作做出来。他预期，机器人领域的模型一两年内可能出现突破。

谈到全球普及，他给出的时间尺度是 10 到 20 年，理由是家庭、工厂和商业服务需要各自完成工程适配，制造端也需要时间爬坡。
title_en: Unitree Founder Predicts Chinese Robot Production Will Overtake Autos in 5 to 10 Years
content_en:
China's annual robot production capacity could surpass that of automobiles within the next 5 to 10 years, according to Wang Xingxing, founder of Unitree Robotics, speaking at the WISE 2026 conference on November 26. Using China's annual output of roughly 20 million vehicles as a benchmark, Wang noted that robots require smaller physical footprints and fewer model variations, allowing individual factories to yield significantly higher output once manufacturing workflows are established.

Addressing current technological hurdles, Wang highlighted that fine-tuned motion control and tactile feedback during physical contact remain critical bottlenecks. While general multimodal AI models excel at understanding environments and making high-level decisions, specialized robotics models are essential for hardware execution. He anticipates major breakthroughs in robotics-oriented AI models over the next one to two years.

Despite rapid technological progress, Wang offered a more conservative timeframe of 10 to 20 years for global market adoption. He cited the extensive engineering adaptations needed across diverse environments—such as households, factories, and commercial services—alongside the time required to scale up global manufacturing.

title_zh: 新一代小米 SU7 Ultra 申报，新增双座布局
content_zh:
工信部第 414 批新车公示列出了新一代小米 SU7 Ultra，申报了双座和五座布局，轴距均为 3000mm。车宽有 1970mm 和 2014mm 两种，后胎最宽可选 325mm。

动力仍为三电机四驱。前电机峰值功率 288kW，两台后电机各 425kW，申报最高车速为 318km/h。新车采用宁德时代供应的三元锂离子电池，外观可选装不同的前舱盖、翼子板饰件和尾翼。
title_en: Xiaomi Files for Updated SU7 Ultra Featuring a New Two-Seater Variant
content_en:
Xiaomi has officially filed regulatory documentation with China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) for an updated version of its high-performance SU7 Ultra. The new filings reveal that the vehicle will be offered in both two-seater and five-seater configurations, sharing a 3,000 mm wheelbase with body width options of 1,970 mm and 2,014 mm, alongside optional rear tires up to 325 mm wide.

The powertrain retains a formidable tri-motor four-wheel-drive system, featuring a 288 kW front motor paired with dual 425 kW rear motors, pushing the top declared speed to 318 km/h. Powered by CATL ternary lithium-ion batteries, the updated SU7 Ultra will also offer customizable exterior options, including distinct front hoods, fender trim, and rear spoilers.

title_zh: 拓竹发布首款手持 3D 扫描仪 S1，首发 11499 元起
content_zh:
拓竹 11 月 26 日发布首款 3D 扫描仪 S1。它支持蓝色激光和红外散斑两种光源，机身自带电池、3.5 英寸触控屏和 Wi-Fi 6，可无线把扫描画面传到电脑。屏幕上就能查看进度和调整参数，拓竹给出的高功率模式续航最长为 3.5 小时。

配套的 Bambu Scan 提供 14 类场景预设，按手办、汽车零件或黑色高光物体等目标匹配参数。设备用户可免费使用网格雕刻、尺寸测量和模型偏差热力图等后处理工具，其中部分工具需要将扫描仪连接至电脑。在 Bambu Scan 中处理好的封闭模型可以直接导入 Bambu Studio 打印。

S1 国内初上市价 11999 元起，11 月 26 日 22 点至 12 月 12 日 23 点 59 分的首发价为 11499 元起。Bambu Scan 目前支持 Windows，macOS 版稍后推出。
title_en: Bambu Lab Launches Its First Handheld 3D Scanner S1 Starting at 11,499 Yuan
content_en:
Bambu Lab has officially released its first handheld 3D scanner, the S1. The device features dual light sources—blue laser and infrared speckle—and comes equipped with a built-in battery, a 3.5-inch touchscreen, and Wi-Fi 6 for seamless wireless transmission to a PC. Users can monitor scanning progress and adjust settings directly on the screen, with the battery lasting up to 3.5 hours in high-power mode.

The scanner is supported by the Bambu Scan software, which offers 14 scene presets tailored for objects like action figures, auto parts, and reflective black surfaces. It also includes free post-processing tools such as mesh sculpting, dimensional measurement, and heat maps. Completed models can be directly exported into Bambu Studio for immediate 3D printing.

The Bambu Lab S1 carries a standard starting price of 11,999 yuan, with an introductory promotional price starting at 11,499 yuan available through December 12. Bambu Scan currently supports Windows, with a macOS version scheduled for release later.

title_zh: vivo S70 旗舰版预告变焦闪光灯，补光亮度随焦段调整
content_zh:
vivo 产品经理韩伯啸公布了 S70 系列的首批影像细节。S70 旗舰版内置变焦闪光灯，能随拍摄焦段自动调节亮度。韩伯啸称，其亮度达到上一代的三倍多，并使用了 vivo X 系列旗舰机的闪光人像算法，调整人脸受光后的明暗过渡。

旗舰版还配备采用索尼 LYTIA 610 传感器的 6400 万像素潜望长焦。vivo 另外预告了一套面向暗光人像的外接补光配件，针对夜游、聚餐等弱光场景。官网已开放 S70 系列预约。
title_en: vivo Teases S70 Flagship Edition Featuring a Smart Zoom Flash and Periscope Lens
content_en:
vivo Product Manager Han Boxiao has shared the first camera details for the upcoming vivo S70 series. The S70 Flagship Edition introduces a built-in zoom flash that automatically adjusts its brightness based on the camera's focal length. According to Han, the flash is over three times brighter than its predecessor and incorporates portrait flash algorithms from vivo's flagship X series to smooth out light and shadow transitions on facial features.

Additionally, the flagship variant is equipped with a 64MP periscope telephoto camera powered by the Sony LYTIA 610 sensor. vivo also teased a suite of external fill-light accessories tailored for low-light scenarios, such as night outings and dinner gatherings. Reservations for the S70 series are now open on vivo's official website.

title_zh: 从鼠标轨迹判断用户是否卡住，Libraries.dev 开放测试
content_zh:
设计师兼开发者 Jakub Antalik 开放了一款名为 Mood Recognition 的网页模型测试版。网页可以用光标移动、点击、滚动和键盘操作等信号，推测用户是否搞不清下一步、找不到入口，或反复操作却无法继续。

比如，光标在某个控件周围打转、迟迟没有点击，可能被识别为困惑。连续点击被禁用的按钮，则可能被识别为操作受阻。

模型在浏览器内运行，只读取位置、时序和控件状态等信息。开发者可以用这些信号在当前步骤显示提示，或者突出用户还没找到的控件。

测试版提供 React 工具包，开发测试和非商用项目可免费使用。商业应用发布需取得相应授权。
title_en: Libraries.dev Launches Web Model to Detect User Frustration via Mouse Trajectory
content_en:
Designer and developer Jakub Antalik has released a beta version of "Mood Recognition," an in-browser web model available via Libraries.dev. By analyzing real-time input signals—such as cursor movements, clicks, scrolling, and keyboard actions—the tool infers whether a user is confused, unable to locate UI elements, or stuck in a repetitive loop.

For instance, a cursor hovering or circling an element without clicking may be interpreted as user confusion, while repeatedly clicking a disabled button signals a blocked workflow. Because the model processes data entirely within the browser—focusing solely on timing, position, and UI element states—developers can use these signals to display context-aware hints or highlight overlooked elements in real time.

The beta includes a React toolkit and is free for non-commercial projects and developer testing, while commercial deployments will require a paid license.

title_zh: Nothing 公布 AI 耳机，充电盒也能录会议
content_zh:
Nothing 在 11 月 25 日晚公布了带录音功能的无线耳机 Ear (note)，并把正式发布定在 12 月 8 日。耳机用来录制电话或线上会议，充电盒内的麦克风则负责记录面对面交谈。录音可同步到配套应用，由应用转写并生成摘要。

这次公开的金属充电盒有透明窗口，能看到耳机是否归位。盒身保留了独立的录音键和通话键，线下会议录音需要手动开启，盒上的指示灯会显示设备状态。
title_en: Nothing Unveils Ear (note) AI Earbuds Capable of Recording In-Person Meetings
content_en:
Nothing has announced its upcoming Ear (note) wireless earbuds, featuring built-in AI recording capabilities, with an official release scheduled for December 8.

The earbuds record phone calls and online meetings, while a microphone integrated directly into the charging case captures in-person conversations. Recorded audio automatically syncs to a companion app, which generates transcriptions and AI-powered summaries.

The metallic charging case features a transparent window, dedicated recording and call buttons, and an LED status indicator. Users can manually trigger offline meeting recordings using the dedicated button on the case.

title_zh: 铠侠联手英伟达，用固态硬盘验证 PB 级显存扩展方案
content_zh:
11 月 26 日，铠侠宣布与英伟达开展概念验证，通过英伟达的 SCADA 软件把 NVMe 固态硬盘纳入 GPU 可访问的数据空间。这套方案要解决的是高带宽内存（HBM）容量有限的问题，让大型向量数据库等超出 HBM 容量的数据也能由 GPU 处理。

双方用一套 GB200 NVL72 机架做测试，18 个服务器节点共装有 144 块 7.68 TB 的铠侠 XD8 固态硬盘，原始闪存容量约 1.1 PB。SCADA 支持以 512 字节的小块访问数据。按铠侠的估算，这套配置可容纳约 2 万亿个同样大小的向量。双方接下来将继续评估实际处理性能。
title_en: Kioxia and NVIDIA Partner to Expand GPU Memory into Petabyte Scale via SSDs
content_en:
Kioxia has announced a proof-of-concept collaboration with NVIDIA to integrate NVMe SSDs into GPU-accessible memory space using NVIDIA's SCADA software. The solution aims to bypass High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) capacity limitations, enabling GPUs to process massive datasets like large-scale vector databases.

The testing utilized an NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 rack setup containing 18 server nodes equipped with 144 Kioxia XD8 7.68TB SSDs, totaling roughly 1.1 petabytes of raw flash storage. Powered by SCADA's fine-grained 512-byte data access, the system can hold approximately two trillion vectors of equivalent size.

Both companies plan to further evaluate the system's real-world processing performance in upcoming tests.

title_zh: 蚂蚁披露阿福的实时健康交互架构
content_zh:
蚂蚁百灵团队披露了实时多模态健康交互架构 LingSante-Live。团队介绍，阿福已上线的音视频健康咨询、健康自检和报告解读使用了这套架构的部分能力。

这套架构把实时语音、持续感知和后台推理分开运行。用户可以在 AI 回答时插话，后台继续跟踪画面变化或查阅资料。解读报告时，系统会在原文高亮当前讲到的指标，用户切换关注内容时，标注和讲解也随之更新。

团队还展示了深蹲训练中的动作计数和姿势提示。演示中，用户可以在训练途中开口调整计划，系统会接着当前进度提供反馈。
title_en: Ant Group Details Real-Time Multimodal Health AI Architecture Powering "AFu"
content_en:
Ant Group's Bailing team has revealed LingSante-Live, a real-time multimodal health interaction architecture. The system powers key features of Ant's AI health assistant, "AFu," including audio-video consultations, health self-checks, and medical report analysis.

LingSante-Live decouples real-time voice processing, continuous perception, and backend reasoning. This design allows users to interrupt the AI mid-sentence while the backend concurrently tracks visual changes or retrieves references. When interpreting medical reports, the system dynamically highlights relevant metrics in real time as explanations update.

The team also demonstrated practical applications in fitness coaching, showing how the system can count reps, provide real-time form corrections during squats, and adapt workout plans mid-exercise without losing track of current progress.

title_zh: 《绘图方块 S CLIMAX》开放试玩，收录系列九作的 1020 道谜题
content_zh:
日本开发商 Jupiter 宣布，《绘图方块 S CLIMAX》将于 12 月 10 日登陆 Switch 和 Switch 2，日本任天堂 eShop 已开放数字版预订及试玩。系列还将首次推出实体版，采用 Switch 2 游戏钥匙卡发行。

本作从《绘图方块 S》到《绘图方块 S9》的九部游戏中选出 1020 道谜题，另外加入高难度奖励关卡。玩家根据每行、每列给出的数字涂格子，最终拼出一张像素图。Jupiter 同时宣布，Switch 上的《绘图方块》系列累计下载量已超过 100 万次。
title_en: Picross S CLIMAX Demo Released: Packed with 1,020 Puzzles Across Nine Titles
content_en:
Japanese developer Jupiter has announced that *Picross S CLIMAX* will launch on Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 on December 10. A digital demo and pre-orders are currently available on the Japanese Nintendo eShop. Notably, the game will also mark the franchise's first physical release, utilizing a Switch 2 game card.

*Picross S CLIMAX* features 1,020 curated puzzles selected from *Picross S* through *Picross S9*, along with new high-difficulty bonus stages. Jupiter also announced that cumulative downloads for the *Picross* series on Nintendo Switch have officially crossed 1 million units.

title_zh: 福特发布 GT41 赛车，明年重返勒芒最高组别
content_zh:
福特在底特律公开展示 GT41 耐力赛车。这款车将从 2027 年起参加世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）最高组别，并在 6 月的勒芒 24 小时耐力赛争夺全场冠军。

GT41 从地面到车顶进气口高 41 英寸，命名延续了 GT40 以车身尺寸命名的做法。GT40 曾在 1966 年至 1969 年连续四次赢得勒芒全场冠军。新车采用深浅两种蓝色的赛车涂装，取代了测试期间使用的迷彩。

福特计划参加 2027 年 WEC 的全部九站比赛，3 月在卡塔尔开启赛季。
title_en: Ford Unveils GT41 Race Car for 2027 Le Mans Top-Class Return
content_en:
Ford has officially revealed its GT41 endurance race car in Detroit, signaling its return to the top class of the FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC) and the 24 Hours of Le Mans starting in 2027.

Measuring just 41 inches high from the ground to the roof intake, the GT41 pays homage to the legendary GT40, which achieved four consecutive overall victories at Le Mans from 1966 to 1969. The vehicle sports a striking dual-blue racing livery, replacing the camouflage wrap used during early testing.

Ford plans to compete across all nine rounds of the 2027 WEC season, kicking off in Qatar in March 2027.

title_zh: 市场监管总局回应部分可乐未标生产日期：企业提前执行新国标
content_zh:
据央视新闻 11 月 26 日报道，市场监管总局食品生产经营司回应了部分可乐瓶身只有到期日、没有生产日期的疑问。该司表示，相关企业提前执行了新版《食品安全国家标准 预包装食品标签通则》。

新标准将于 2027 年 3 月 16 日实施，并允许企业提前执行。一般预包装食品须清晰标出生产日期和保质期到期日。保质期达到 6 个月的预包装食品，可只标注保质期时长和到期日，生产日期由企业选择是否标注。消费者可以直接查看到期日，无需再从生产日期往后推算。

部分中粮可口可乐产品正在分批换标，计划在新标准实施前完成。过渡期间，新老两种包装会同时在售。
title_en: Chinese Regulator Clarifies Omitted Production Dates on Coca-Cola Bottles
content_en:
China's State Administration for Market Regulation has responded to public queries regarding certain Coca-Cola bottles displaying expiration dates without production dates. The agency clarified that beverage manufacturers are voluntarily implementing an updated national food safety labeling standard ahead of schedule.

Under the new standard—set to officially take effect on March 16, 2027—prepackaged foods with a shelf life of at least six months are permitted to omit the production date, provided the shelf life duration and expiration date are clearly stated. This update allows consumers to directly verify product freshness without calculating back from the production date.

COFCO Coca-Cola is currently rolling out the updated labels across its product line in phases. Both old and new packaging formats will temporarily coexist in the market during the transition period.

title_zh: 18 家平台企业完成算法协商，美团和淘宝闪购取消超时扣款
content_zh:
据央视新闻，中华全国总工会 11 月 26 日公布了平台劳动规则和算法协商结果。截至 11 月 10 日，网络货运、网约车、网约配送、快递四个行业的 18 家重点平台企业已签订协议，覆盖超过 2500 万名新就业形态劳动者。

协议涉及派单、计价、分成和申诉。美团和淘宝闪购取消超时扣款处罚，顺丰承诺提前 30 天公示涉及收入的重大调整，滴滴和 T3 出行把当地小时最低工资标准写入协议。T3 出行还规定在 72 小时内反馈司机申诉处理结果。

全国总工会接下来将指导部分重点城市和企业开展二次协商，把协商成果延伸至分支机构及用工合作企业。
title_en: China’s Tech Giants Scrap Late Penalties and Improve Gig Worker Rights in Landmark Union Negotiations
content_en:
Eighteen major Chinese platform companies across freight, ride-hailing, food delivery, and courier logistics have completed labor rule and algorithm negotiations with the All-China Federation of Trade Unions (ACFTU). The agreements cover more than 25 million gig workers, establishing new standards for task dispatching, pricing, revenue sharing, and dispute resolution.

Under the landmark deal, major delivery platforms including Meituan and Taobao Flash Sale have completely abolished financial penalties for late deliveries. SF Express pledged to provide a 30-day advance notice for any major income-related policy changes, while ride-hailing giants Didi and T3 Mobility formally integrated local hourly minimum wage standards into driver agreements. T3 Mobility also committed to resolving driver appeals within 72 hours.

The ACFTU announced plans to guide secondary negotiations in key cities to extend these labor protections to regional branches and third-party staffing partners.

title_zh: 《GTA 6》登顶日本周销量榜，PS5 数字版主机同期卖出约 4 万台
content_zh:
《Fami 通》公布了 11 月 16 日至 22 日的日本游戏销量估算。《GTA 6》在 11 月 19 日发售，PS5 版以 200,759 份登顶。该榜单合计实体包装、下载卡和预装版本。

硬件方面，PS5 数字版同期售出 40,362 台，超过售出 36,817 台的 Switch 2。软件榜第二名是 Switch 2 版《塞尔达传说：时之笛》，销量估算为 35,295 份。
title_en: 'GTA 6' Tops Weekly Sales Charts in Japan as PS5 Digital Edition Beats Switch 2
content_en:
*Grand Theft Auto VI* dominated the Japanese gaming software charts for the week of November 16–22, moving an estimated 200,759 units on PlayStation 5 following its November 19 launch, according to retail data from *Famitsu*. The sales total includes physical boxed copies, download cards, and pre-installed versions.

The blockbuster release also provided a major hardware boost. The PS5 Digital Edition sold 40,362 units during the same period, surpassing the Switch 2, which recorded 36,817 units. On the software side, the Switch 2 edition of *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* claimed the runner-up spot with 35,295 copies sold.

title_zh: 《愚者之夜》登陆 Netflix，SUNRISE 与 SHAFT 首次联手制作动画
content_zh:
Netflix 将于 11 月 26 日一次放出日本动画《愚者之夜》的全部集数。这是制作过《星际牛仔》的 SUNRISE 和制作过《魔法少女小圆》的 SHAFT 首次联手，作品改编自安田佳澄的同名漫画，由汤川敦之执导、田中仁负责系列构成。

故事发生在阳光被厚重云层遮蔽的未来。为维持氧气供应，人类开始把濒死者转化为植物。年轻人神谷十四郎接受这项手术后，发现自己能听见转化者的声音，并被委派协助调查一起案件。乐队 Tempalay 为动画演唱了片头曲。
title_en: Netflix Premieres Dark Sci-Fi Anime 'Fool Night', Marking Historic Sunrise and Shaft Collaboration
content_en:
Netflix is debuting the complete animated series *Fool Night* on November 26, marking the first-ever co-production between iconic anime studios Sunrise (*Cowboy Bebop*) and Shaft (*Puella Magi Madoka Magica*). Based on the manga by Kasumi Yasuda, the adaptation is directed by Atsushi Yukawa, with Jin Tanaka handling series composition.

Set in a bleak future where heavy clouds block out sunlight, humanity relies on a procedure that converts dying individuals into oxygen-producing plants. The story follows Toshiro Kamiya, a young man who undergoes the surgery and discovers he can hear the voices of the converted, leading him to assist in a mysterious investigation. Japanese band Tempalay performed the opening theme song for the series.

title_zh: 《南方公园》第 29 季收官，把《GTA 6》写进停电风波
content_zh:
动画剧集《南方公园》第 29 季最后一集「City Endings」于当地时间 11 月 25 日在 Comedy Central 播出，次日在美国、加拿大和澳大利亚的 Paramount+ 上线。全季共六集。

这一集从南方公园镇的神秘停电讲起。卡特曼等人因停电玩不了《GTA 6》，出门调查停电原因。镇民怀疑是网络攻击，几个孩子在外面碰见肯尼的鬼魂。制作方已释出两段正片片段，分别展示了几人打游戏和停电后在镇上游荡的桥段。
title_en: South Park Season 29 Finale Features GTA 6 in Blackout Mystery
content_en:
The 29th season of the animated series *South Park* concluded with its six-episode finale, titled "City Endings." The episode premiered on Comedy Central on November 25 and launched on Paramount+ across the US, Canada, and Australia the following day.

In the finale, a sudden blackout interrupts Cartman and his friends' *GTA 6* gaming session, prompting the boys to venture out and investigate the cause. As panicked residents fear a cyberattack, the group encounters Kenny's ghost while wandering the darkened town.

title_zh: 《暗黑》主创制作的新剧《Sonnental》首曝预告，明年 3 月上线
content_zh:
德国 HBO 原创悬疑剧《Sonnental》发布首支预告和剧照。全剧共 6 集，将于 2027 年 3 月登陆 HBO Max，由《暗黑》的两位主创扬特耶·弗里泽和巴伦·博·欧达担任制片，伦纳特·鲁夫执导。

曾在《暗黑》中饰演玛莎的莉萨·维卡里，这次饰演一名德国联邦刑警局的犯罪侧写师。连环命案把她带回故乡，现场布置都取材于德国童书《蓬头彼得》。彼得·库尔特饰演与她一同查案的警探。
title_en: Teaser Released for 'Sonnental,' New Mystery Drama from 'Dark' Creators
content_en:
HBO Germany has released the first teaser and stills for *Sonnental*, an upcoming six-episode mystery drama. Executive produced by *Dark* creators Jantje Friese and Baran bo Odar and directed by Lennart Ruff, the series is slated to debut on HBO Max in March 2027.

Lisa Vicari (*Dark*) stars as a profiler for Germany's Federal Criminal Police Office who is pulled back to her hometown by a series of murders. The crime scenes bizarrely draw inspiration from the classic German children's book *Struwwelpeter*. Peter Kurth co-stars as the lead detective partnering with her on the case.
